title: Haloumi Grain Bowl
subtitle: with Quinoa, Kale and Raisins
description: This grain bowl, loaded with greens, doused in a sweet lemon dressing and topped with golden slices of haloumi, is equal parts oh so good and good for you.

steps.text: Cook quinoa: Rinse 100g (½ cup) quinoa (see Kitchen tip) well in a sieve, then drain. Put in a small saucepan with 180ml (¾ cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 7 mins, then add the raisins and cook for a further 5-7 mins until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is tender. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for 5 mins.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, coarsely grate the broccoli, including the stems. Discard the centre stems from the kale and finely shred the leaves. Finely grate the zest of half the lemon, then juice the half. Cut the haloumi into thick strips. Crush 1 garlic clove.

Cook haloumi and greens: Lightly spray or brush a medium frypan with olive oil and heat over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1 min each side or until golden. Remove and respray the pan. Cook the broccoli, stirring, for 2 mins or until tender. Remove and respray the pan. Add the kale and 1 tbs water, season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 3 mins or until wilted.
Make dressing: Meanwhile, put the garlic, lemon zest, 1 tbs lemon juice, 2 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp dijon mustard and 1 tsp honey in a small bowl and whisk to combine.

Serve up: Put the quinoa and raisins, greens and half the dressing in a large bowl and toss to combine. Divide the salad among bowls, top with the haloumi, drizzle with the remaining dressing and enjoy.

Kitchen tip: To keep within our healthy guidelines only 100g quinoa is used. However, it would be equally delicious if you decide to add all the quinoa. Simply add an extra 60ml (¼ cup) water to the pan when cooking the quinoa.
